epic.title: worktree identity by git, compared by equality (tc1)
epic.intent_and_why: checklist_engine.origin_worktree_refusal compared worktree identity by containment (is_relative_to), which #585's nested `<root>/.worktrees/<slug>` layout made unsafe: every worktree is now literally inside the primary checkout, so a primary-stamped spine was drivable from inside any worktree. The Admiral ruling replaces containment with git-worktree-identity equality, resolved at the engine's single impure call site.

definition_of_done: A primary-stamped spine is refused from inside a nested worktree (was allowed before).
The predicate stays pure and unmodified in its test_it_is_pure coverage.
Fail-closed: no resolvable git toplevel + origin-carrying spine -> refused; origin-less/malformed spines unchanged.
The one authorized test migration (subdirectory-passes) lands, moved not deleted.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Cache-clean full suite >= measured baseline (3002 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed, 1130 subtests at 453f8492), zero failures.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Red-before/green-after over real behavior (real git repos, real git worktree add), independently reproduced by implementer, reviewer, and Commander.
good_enough.appetite: One bounded gate, single-file-pair scope (LAUNCH_ORDER File Ownership).

hard_constraints: Do not edit scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py, scripts/mcp_spine_server.py, .mcp.json, or .worktrees/epic-568-441/.
fixed_decisions: decision:git-not-lexical — call site resolves cwd via git worktree toplevel, not lexical containment or an exported --from.
decision:forgery-stays-open — chdir-into-the-stamped-worktree still passes; not closed by this change.
decision:no-migration — origin.worktree values are immutable engine identity.
decision:test-migration-authorized — the subdirectory-passes property moves from the pure predicate to a main()-level real-git-repo assertion.

current_wave.objective: Implement the 2026-08-15 worktree-identity ruling in scripts/checklist_engine.py and migrate tests/test_spine_origin_isolation.py accordingly.
exit_criteria: Nested-worktree regression refuses after the change (red before, green after).

completed_outcomes.evidence: git diff scripts/checklist_engine.py; wiring grep shows exactly one rev-parse --show-toplevel call site, in main(), none in the predicate. python -m pytest tests/test_spine_origin_isolation.py -v -> 37 passed, 1 skipped, 16 subtests passed (independently reproduced by Commander).
